nodes.label: desktop memory - the gold-100 ported to v3

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The gold-100 scored set lives in v3 at v3/data/gold100.jsonl - 100 lines of {"id": "<Stem>::a::<index>"}, the format orchestrator._read_ids consumes, with no header comment because the loader is strict JSON-per-line. It was ported from the authoritative v1 selection v1/frontend/scripts/ragas-questions.herb-gold100.jsonl, v1's round-robin pick with ids of the form gold_<product>_<index>, by a clean mechanical re-key from lowercase stem to v3 file stem at the same index, since v1's item_index equals the v3 array position. Every id was verified present in v3/data/questions.jsonl with an exact question-text match before writing, with no guessing. The set is 100 entries, and the effective-n99 note is about a v1 runtime abort on one question, not the set size
